diagnosis.load_stage_structural_rejection: EXCLUDED by this diff: every loader-parsed structure (fself fields, ELF header, program headers, sections, dynamic table, dynsym, relocations, init/fini arrays, notes) is field-wise equivalent or size-consequence-only
diagnosis.zero_records_reconciliation: record_sink.c opens O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_APPEND|O_NOFOLLOW (no O_SYNC, no fsync) and every record is a synchronous sceKernelWrite; the igf5 flow writes seq 1-3 BEFORE the first mprotect. Hence a plain userspace crash after module_start would have left records 1-3 on disk. Zero records + console crash therefore points to (i) LEADING: a kernel-level fault from the unverified raw syscall 74 on this kernel (unexpected sysent semantics -> kernel panic), losing unsynced page-cache writes and taking down console+game; or (ii) module_start never ran (load-stage event outside the parsed structures, e.g. content-derived console validation) — made unlikely by (a)-(g) but not strictly excludable on host
diagnosis.confirmed_caveat: per task instruction the syscall is NOT declared the proven cause; it is the sole execution-relevant binary delta and the first igf5-only instruction that would ever execute. Static analysis cannot distinguish (i) from (ii) on this host; only a user-coordinated launch of a syscall-free build can
diagnosis.igf6_response: remove the entire mechanism (no mprotect import, no shim, no raw syscall, no permission gate) and direct-read the anchors: x86-64 NX gates execute, not read; VMMAP prot=0x4 is kernel policy; igf4's refusal was the GATE refusing (policy), never the hardware faulting
